limitation: Robustness experiment on the available recordings. DAT255 was trained on DeepShip, so these recordings may already have appeared in its training data. Training overlap has not been ruled out; a new split of these files cannot establish that the pretrained model has never encountered them.
training_note: Upstream notebook uses MixUp on spectrogram inputs; waveform mixing is a distinct perturbation.
statistical_note: Scenarios reuse recordings and sometimes vessels. No independent-trial significance tests or confidence intervals.
signal_note: Levels use mean-subtracted recording RMS, not calibrated isolated-vessel sound power. Background noises are mixed too.
temporal_note: Active-interval AC SIR is held at 0 dB for partial overlaps; same centred B fragment is moved for placement comparisons.
